title: Steve Yegge: 'You'll Never Write Code the Same Way Again'
description:
Steve Yegge (Sourcegraph, ex-Amazon, ex-Google, author of the Google Platforms Rant) sits down with Tessl's Dru Knox to break down what a "software factory" actually is — and why the rules of software engineering are being rewritten in real time. From swarming agents to token-maxing benders to a 100-year bug backlog, this conversation covers the messy reality of building at the edge of what AI can do.

What we cover:
– What actually makes something a "software factory" versus just using a coding agent
– How Tessl builds internally with zero human-written code and zero interactive agent sessions
– Why less human code review starts with agents reviewing themselves first
– The risks, training gaps, and what it takes to get an entire org AI-literate
– Steve's take on ambition, burnout, and why the work never runs out
